task: photo-editing flagship: a real NEF split row

errors.what: First batch run of the checker reported 11,153 differing J5 sensels after a fresh-process run reported 0 in the same rows
errors.cause: LibRaw leaves rows past its per-model height unwritten (leftover memory after earlier files), so an 'all zero' test was fragile
errors.fix: compare only rows LibRaw decodes, report the rest

doc_friction.issue: Said the edge rule 'cut nothing' and failures were 'a margin kept, never picture cut'; true for its seven files, wrong on the first busy 12/14-bit lossy frames (D3400, D5600). Corrected in README and the new eval.

Black level from 0x003D was checked only on 14-bit files; the 12-bit scaling was unknown and every 12-bit NEF since ~2014 developed nearly black. The test set's bit depth gap is worth naming when a reader is called checked.

notes: Routed ventures/1; allocate.py picked photo-editing (row 5). Probed 235 raw.pixls.us NEFs by HTTP range request, 11 with split rows. Split rows decoded right; fixed Z 6II 0x44 0x40, 12-bit black scale, edge-rule bar. Verification: tools/nef_libraw_check.py on 18 real NEFs exit 0 (native), Python reference 6 of 6; stress 53/54 picture-only whole; run_venture_tests.py photo-editing 1190 tests OK; post front matter/link/similarity checks clean; venture-preflight.mjs photo-editing: clean (exit 0). RW2 tone-curve item probed first: the RawFormat 8 files of three bodies not checked before (S1R II x3, S1 II ES, S5 IIX) carry identity curves in 0x39/0x3A, and the G97 file is RawFormat 4, so no file with a tone curve was found.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: probe 235 files, debug three decoder faults against LibRaw, tests, eval and post: about 1.5 days of a raw-format engineer

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
